parents.subject: Materials Science and Engineering
parents.course: Laboratory Studies in Materials Science and Engineering

ns2:section.sectionText: Exploration of emerging materials of reduced dimensionality through hands-on experiments. Students learn to handle/process atomically thin materials such as graphene, fabricate field-effect transistors from these materials, and carry out various means of characterization including electrical, Raman, and optical measurements. In addition, effects of external stimuli (e.g., mechanical and chemical) on electrical characteristics are also examined.
